mapper.sql: FROM sys_site_message_recipient r INNER JOIN sys_site_message m ON m.id = r.message_id AND m.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, message_id, user_id, read_at, deleted, created_at FROM sys_site_message_recipient WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT r.id, r.message_id, m.message_subject, m.message_category, NULL AS message_content, m.sender_id, m.sender_name, m.sent_at, r.read_at, CASE WHEN r.read_at IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS read_status
ORDER BY m.sent_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sys_site_message_recipient (id, tenant_id, message_id, user_id, read_at, deleted, created_at) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.messageId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.readAt}, #{item.deleted}, #{item.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_site_message_recipient WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.sql: FROM sys_site_message_recipient r INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id AND u.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(u.real_name), ''), u.username) AS user_nickname, u.username, r.read_at, CASE WHEN r.read_at IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS read_status
ORDER BY (r.read_at IS NULL) DESC, user_nickname ASC, u.username ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
